text: That drift thing is what gets me. I'd guess the feeling is the part that gets rewritten, because it's the only part we're still carrying around. The facts go stale, but the emotional tag gets re-checked every time we think about it, so it slowly takes on whatever we currently believe about the person. Which makes me wonder how much of "I remember a year ago" is really "I remember what I decided it meant."
